sources.title: Anima Aesthetic 1.0b Text-to-Image Workflow - civitai.com
sources.snippet: Suitable for model comparison, anime illustration, character art, and stylized image testing Suggested workflow: Use this workflow beside Anima Aesthetic 1.0 and compare results under the same prompt. Do not judge it only by speed. Look at aesthetic direction, color balance, character design, composition, background handling, and detail stability.
